name: Harness AI
description: Scaffolds AI agent, skill and command assets (Claude Code, OpenCode) into the workspace. All configuration — tools, install toggles, content repos — lives in the workspace's .harness-ai/config.yaml, the single source of truth; this feature has no options. Merges content from the bundled harness-ai source, skillPaths/agentPaths/commandPaths fetched from a path inside another repo (frompaths), N named contentRepos (each of which can ship its own custom.yaml to add install commands and path entries), an auto-detected workspace-local .harness-ai/local/ source, and the hand-authored .harness-ai/skills/local/, .harness-ai/agents/local/ and .harness-ai/commands/local/ convention, and never overwrites real content it doesn't recognize. Symlinks CLAUDE.md to the scaffolded AGENTS.md when claude is an active tool. Provisions at container create via a config-driven CLI (harnessai) and re-syncs on every start when content has changed.
